pool_snapshot: v15, retrieved 2026-11-14, 226191 main rows, 10838 quarantined rows

external.calibration: sha256(prompt) modulo 20 equals 0; all remaining prompts train experts

eb.selection: external prompt five-fold CV inside each frozen native fold; official outer prompt folds never select EB parameters
eb.class_composition: subtract external per-class mean then add balanced external mean before regression
eb.runtime: reuse exact qwen_groups.py E_q; n/(n+tau) observed + tau/(n+tau) predicted; singleton centered head enabled
eb.gate: native-alone sparse1-2 BA delta paired prompt-bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0

training.official_exclusions: five single-fold exclusions + ten pair exclusions for clean outer-fold SAGE training
training.init: raw pinned embedding backbone + new discriminative LoRA/head; never continue native
training.evaluation: immediately GPU-score final checkpoint on excluded official rows; no CPU large-model fallback

sage.gate: both top-2 candidates in same enabled disjoint expert group
sage.validation_input: native alone, one fixed sparse1-2 grouping seed2000; no parent mixture
sage.deployment_input: frozen full public stack after native share0.40
sage.deployment_fold: sha256(row_id) modulo5; one fold of at most one expert per row
sage.kaggle_memory: one worker shards each FP16 8B expert across both T4s; groups loaded sequentially, no unvalidated quantization
sage.acceptance: expert group OOF accuracy > native restricted-group accuracy AND post-SAGE family-conditional delta 95% lower bound >0; combined accepted experts must also pass

validation.scope: official train prompt OOF validation; hidden test not evaluated locally
validation.family_conditional: exact correct / family correct, both numerator and denominator resampled
validation.public_native_second_order: Public native OOF states are frozen supplied assets. New expert pair exclusions remove new expert-to-SAGE outer-label paths; this does not reconstruct public native pretraining as nested models.

gpu_layout: one GPU for each expert group; fourth GPU for frozen EB collection; fewer authorized idle GPUs may fill dynamically
build: only individually accepted components; neither passes => no build or submission
api_budget: never spend automatically; ask user only if additional generated data is needed
leaderboard: optional auxiliary calibration after v5.0 score arrives; never blocks implementation or changes gates
